sources.games: 410 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 46.3%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py mirana.
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 9 (abilities named in fight and skills), 7.41f.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-11-07 (support wave): the build follows the STRATZ high-rank order where it and the league games disagree; Eul's Scepter answers Phantom Strike and Charge of Darkness (Jakiro, Rubick, Skywrath Mage, Tusk); Rod of Atos against escapes (a root stops walking and blink escapes); Ghost Scepter against two physical carries stays on thin samples; the skill builds and talents are the most common ones. Solar Crest against evasion dropped: its barrier and armor do nothing against evasion.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute (parts and consumables dropped): arcane_boots 52% (13), essence_distiller 42% (15), cyclone 43% (24), ultimate_scepter 43% (34). STRATZ pos4 (8648 games): Essence Distiller 13 min, Eul's 21 min (58%), Aghanim's Scepter 29 min (82%); pos5 the same at 12, 21, 30 min. The league build is later by 3-5 min. Ordered by the STRATZ high-rank pos4 minute where STRATZ lists the item (8648 games), else the league minute; Arcane Boots stay first, the league's 13.4 against STRATZ's 13 for the Essence Distiller is no reorder (the player review of 2026-11-07: the STRATZ order where the two disagree).

skills.basis: 410 games since 7.41: maxed mirana_starfall > mirana_arrow > mirana_leap 235 (win 58.3%), mirana_starfall > mirana_arrow 66 (win 13.6%), mirana_starfall > mirana_leap > mirana_arrow 49 (win 53.1%); talents 10: +150 Leap Distance 264/401 (48.1%), -2s Starstorm Cooldown 137/401 (46.0%); 15: Moonlight Shadow gives +20% Evasion 253/277 (57.3%), +90 Leap Attack Speed 24/277 (70.8%); 20: +200 Starstorm Damage 96/97 (76.0%), Celestial Quiver Damage 1/97 (100.0%); 25: +2 Multishot Sacred Arrows 13/13 (76.9%).
